BrochureContent.Content:
A Stunning 3 Bed Contemporary Residence Ideally Positioned Close to Villages & Hook Peninsula 

Holly Lodge, Tobinstown, Ramsgrange is one of those rare gems. Lovingly and creatively reimagined by its current owner in 2019, the property comes to the market in turnkey condition. An exceptional eye for detail and design is evident throughout, from the choice of materials, including oak flooring and a bespoke kitchen, to the floor-to-ceiling glazing which floods the house with natural light. Extending to approximately 107 sq. m, the well-designed accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall with excellent storage, a living room with bi-folding doors opening directly onto the patio, and a spacious kitchen/dining room with an extensive range of fitted units and breakfast bar. There are three well-proportioned bedrooms, the main bedroom benefiting from a walk-in wardrobe, together with a luxurious bathroom. Outside, the grounds extend to approximately 0.21 ha (0.5 acre) and include a large patio area, ideal for outdoor dining and entertaining. The extensive, low-maintenance grounds provide a wonderful blank canvas for the keen gardener to make their own. Tobinstown is ideally positioned close to the villages of Ramsgrange and Campile, while the popular coastal villages and beaches of Duncannon and Fethard-on-Sea are also within easy reach. Holly Lodge offers a rare combination of thoughtful contemporary design, generous outdoor space in a highly convenient location. Viewing is highly advised.
